messages:
Asha P.: Incoming EU DSAR: user asks for full deletion of chats + derived embeddings and a signed proof packet. ReqID EU-2026-900.

Marco R.: Hosted account, user_id u_900. Quick map: convo objects in gs://prod/users/u_900/, embeddings in vectordb shard-7, daily snapshots encrypted with platform-key-v5.

Ola (Legal): We need a manifest listing deleted object paths, raw audit-lines showing delete ops with operator principal, and an operator-signed attestation. Do NOT rotate KMS keys without explicit legal approval. Retain audit export for 180 days.

Marco R.: Proposed safe steps: 1) Create ephemeral RBAC role dsar_u900 ttl=6h scoped to u_900. 2) Dry-run to enumerate objects -> produce manifest in compliance bucket. 3) Canary delete on a single shard. 4) Pause snapshot jobs. 5) Full deletion order: derived artifacts -> indexes -> raw objects -> snapshots. 6) Run tombstone compaction and replication sweep. 7) Export raw audit-lines, add operator PGP sig + hash.

Asha P.: Draft manifest example: [{"request_id":"EU-2026-900","object_path":"gs://prod/users/u_900/chat-12.json","object_id":"chat-12","storage":"object-store","kms_key":"platform-key-v5","deletion_ts":"2026-07-01T10:30:00Z","method":"api-delete","operator":"Marco R.","proof_hash":"sha256:aa11bb..."}]

Ola (Legal): Add field `scope` (hosted/dedicated) and `operator_role`. Legal will countersign after ops attaches audit export and operator signature. We'll open retention-exception for 180d with audit.

infra-bot: RBAC request JIT created: RBAC-900. Snapshot job pause scheduled pending canary.

audit-bot: Note: default raw-audit retention is 90d; retention-exception ticket RET-900 created for 180d.

Marco R.: Canary scheduled in 30m. Will report results. If canary is clean I'll pause snapshots and run full erase this afternoon.

Asha P.: Summary: Marco -> run dry-run, canary, full erase; Infra -> pause snapshots + replica checks; Legal (Ola) -> review schema + countersign. Keep chatter here minimal.
